The usage Reef

Every command that reports a coding agent's quota window and shows where it is heading

O Reef usage

Todos os comandos que informam a janela de cota de um agente de código e mostram para onde ela vai

Opening · the kind

A UsageWindow is the last reading kept of one quota window

  • UsageWindow: spec has used (0 to 100), resetsAt and readAt; status has timeZone, copied from its Mandate
  • The share only grows: within one window the highest reading wins, and the reset only moves forward
  • Through the Nereus API only: the CLI never opens a kubeconfig (ADR 0018)
Abertura · o kind

Uma UsageWindow é a última leitura guardada de uma janela de cota

  • UsageWindow: o spec tem used (de 0 a 100), resetsAt e readAt; o status tem timeZone, copiado do seu Mandate
  • A fatia só cresce: dentro de uma janela vence a leitura mais alta, e o reset só anda para a frente
  • Só pela Nereus API: a CLI nunca abre um kubeconfig (ADR 0018)
Opening · person and account

Each person's Anthropic account keeps its own window

  • The key is the person and the account (#1630): one person logs in with a personal account and a company one, each with its own reset
  • Nothing new to type: the CLI sends the account Claude Code is logged in with, and get shows that one
  • Open to every person: each token reads and writes only its own windows
  • The local cache keeps one folder per account: switching accounts keeps both
Abertura · pessoa e conta

Cada conta Anthropic de uma pessoa guarda a sua janela

  • A chave é a pessoa e a conta (#1630): uma pessoa entra com uma conta pessoal e uma da empresa, cada uma com o seu reset
  • Nada novo para digitar: a CLI manda a conta com que o Claude Code está logado, e o get mostra essa
  • Aberto a toda pessoa: cada token lê e escreve só as suas janelas
  • O cache local guarda uma pasta por conta: trocar de conta mantém as duas
Window · usage reportbuilt #1590

report sends a reading, read now

Janela · usage reportpronto #1590

O report envia uma leitura, feita agora

~/example
# 75% used, resetting on Monday at 01:00 in São Paulo$ nereus usage report weekly \    --used 75 \    --resets-at 2026-11-16T01:00:00-03:00✓ usage/windows/weekly reported (75% used, resets Mon 16/11 01:00) Next steps:   nereus usage get weekly
Window · usage report --replacebuilt #2128

--replace says the share really went down

Janela · usage report --replacepronto #2128

O --replace diz que a fatia caiu de verdade

~/example
# The usage was reset mid-week: 98% kept, 91% now$ nereus usage report weekly \    --used 91 \    --resets-at 2026-11-16T01:00:00-03:00 \    --replace✓ usage/windows/weekly replaced 98% (91% used, resets Mon 16/11 01:00), forecast 110.7% slow Next steps:   nereus usage get weekly # The forecast at 91%, the days gone kept, today never negative$ nereus usage get weeklyWINDOW  USED  RESETS           FORECAST  PACE  TODAY  READweekly  91%   Mon 16/11 01:00  111%      slow  ≤92%   Sat 19:06 DAY        SHARE  TOTAL  IDEAL  PROJECTED  GAPMon 09/11  ~+18%  ~18%   14%               +4Tue 10/11  ~+18%  ~36%   28%               +8Wed 11/11  ~+19%  ~55%   42%               +13Thu 12/11  ~+18%  ~73%   57%               +16Fri 13/11  +18%   91%    71%               +20Sat 14/11  +0%    91%    82%    94%        +9   todaySun 15/11  +8%    100%   100%   111%       +11  plan
Window · usage offlinebuilt #1592

offline, report keeps the reading locally and get answers from it

Janela · usage offlinepronto #1592

Offline, o report guarda a leitura localmente e o get responde a partir dela

~/example
# Nereus unreachable: the reading goes to the local cache$ nereus usage report weekly \    --used 75 \    --resets-at 2026-11-16T01:00:00-03:00✓ usage/windows/weekly kept locally (75% used, resets Mon 16/11 01:00): Nereus unreachable, next try in 5m Next steps:   nereus usage get weekly # The figures computed from the cache, marked local$ nereus usage get weeklyWINDOW  USED  RESETS           FORECAST  PACE    TODAY  READweekly  75%   Mon 16/11 01:00  91%       steady  ≤79%   local Sat 19:06
Window · usage applybuilt #1590

apply writes the windows of a file, under the same rules

Janela · usage applypronto #1590

O apply grava as janelas de um arquivo, sob as mesmas regras

~/example
# A file of UsageWindows, or a folder of them$ nereus usage apply \    --from-file weekly.yaml✓ usage/windows/weekly created Next steps:   nereus usage list
Window · usage getbuilt #1591

get shows the forecast at the reset, today's goal and the week day by day

Janela · usage getpronto #1591

O get mostra a previsão no reset, a meta de hoje e a semana dia a dia

~/example
# The times in the window's time zone$ nereus usage get weeklyWINDOW  USED  RESETS           FORECAST  PACE    TODAY  READweekly  75%   Mon 16/11 01:00  91%       steady  ≤75%   Sat 19:06 DAY        SHARE  TOTAL  IDEAL  PROJECTED  GAPMon 09/11  +10%   10%    14%               -4Tue 10/11  ~+11%  ~21%   28%               -7Wed 11/11  +10%   31%    42%               -11Thu 12/11  +10%   41%    57%               -16Fri 13/11  +19%   60%    71%               -11Sat 14/11  +15%   75%    82%    78%        -7   todaySun 15/11  +25%   100%   100%   91%        -9   plan
Window · usage dayoffbuilt #2111

A day off leaves a date out of the figures

Janela · usage dayoffpronto #2111

Uma folga deixa uma data fora dos números

~/example
# A sick day, marked after it passed$ nereus usage dayoff create 2026-11-10 \    --reason Sick✓ usage/dayoffs/2026-11-10 created # The days off of the account logged in$ nereus usage dayoff listDATE        DAY  REASON2026-11-10  Tue  Sick # Freed: a worked day again$ nereus usage dayoff delete 2026-11-10✓ usage/dayoffs/2026-11-10 deleted
Window · usage workweekbuilt #2111

The work week leaves the weekdays not worked out, and get marks every day off

Janela · usage workweekpronto #2111

A semana de trabalho tira os dias da semana sem trabalho, e o get marca cada folga

~/example
# Weekends off$ nereus usage workweek create \    --off sat=Weekend \    --off sun=Weekend✓ usage/workweek created # A Saturday off: no worked time left before the reset, so the forecast is final$ nereus usage get weeklyWINDOW  USED  RESETS           FORECAST  PACE   TODAY  READweekly  75%   Mon 16/11 01:00  75%       final  off    Sat 19:06 DAY        SHARE  TOTAL  IDEAL  PROJECTED  GAPMon 09/11  +10%   10%    24%               -14Tue 10/11  ~+11%  ~21%   24%               -3   off: SickWed 11/11  +10%   31%    49%               -18Thu 12/11  +10%   41%    75%               -34Fri 13/11  +19%   60%    100%              -40Sat 14/11  +15%   75%    100%   75%        -25  today off: WeekendSun 15/11  +0%    75%    100%   75%        -25  plan off: Weekend
Window · usage list and deletebuilt #1590

list shows every window, delete forgets one

Janela · usage list e deletepronto #1590

O list mostra todas as janelas, o delete esquece uma

~/example
# The same columns as get$ nereus usage listWINDOW  USED  RESETS           FORECAST  PACE    TODAY  READweekly  75%   Mon 16/11 01:00  91%       steady  ≤79%   Sat 19:06 # The window and its reading$ nereus usage delete weeklyusage/windows/weekly deleted Next steps:   nereus usage list
